text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV1 - eu-west-3 ELB 5xx spike + EBS IO latency observed across a subset of instances. Triggered by healthcheck failures. Paging oncall.

alice.dev: seeing a sudden spike in 5xx from app-elb-euw3-prod, avg 5xx rate 18% over last 5m. CloudWatch shows ELB backend_5xx_count up and target unhealthys.

ben-sre: agree. Also EBS ioaverage returning high latency on a few nodes: i-0abc1234 and i-0def5678. Logs show repeated attach/detach messages around 2026-03-17T09:40Z.

dan-oncall: I'm on it. Shifting traffic from eu-west-3 to eu-central-1 via Route53 weighted policy as mitigation. Applying temporary weight: eu-west-3=10, eu-central-1=90.

carla-pm: customer-impact: a subset of EU users hitting low-throughput / timeouts. Support ticket volume is rising. ETA for update pls.

dan-oncall: ran quick check:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg:... | jq '.TargetHealthDescriptions[] | select(.Target.Id=="i-0abc1234")'
```
Result: Unhealthy, Reason: "Target.ResponseCode:504". Also seeing many idle connections piling on LB.

alice.dev: idle_conn counts on ELB look abnormal. Kernel conntrack on hosts shows many TIME_WAIT -> possible ELB idle-conn leak from reverse-proxy config. Pushing restart of nginx on affected hosts to clear conn state.

ben-sre: performing rolling drain of unhealthy targets in tg:prod-euw3. Running `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --targets Id=i-0abc1234` then let ASG add replacements.

aws-alerts: AWS Notification: We are aware of increased EBS latency in eu-west-3, investigating potential control plane throttling.

dan-oncall: Request to infra: please hold autoscaling launch size steady, we want graceful drains not rapid churn. Adding 30s delay on lifecycle hooks.

alice.dev: applied nginx reload and adjusted keepalive_timeout from 75 to 15 on affected hosts to reduce idle sockets. Monitoring.

ben-sre: initiated Route53 change:
```
{
  "Changes": [
    { "Action": "UPSERT", "ResourceRecordSet": { "Name": "api.redwood.example.", "Type": "A", "SetIdentifier": "euw3-weight", "Weight": 10, "TTL": 60, "ResourceRecords": [{"Value":"52.210.10.5"}] } },
    { "Action": "UPSERT", "ResourceRecordSet": { "Name": "api.redwood.example.", "Type": "A", "SetIdentifier": "euc1-weight", "Weight": 90, "TTL": 60, "ResourceRecords": [{"Value":"3.120.45.9"}] } }
  ]
}
```
Change submitted, awaiting propagation (~1-2 minutes).

carla-pm: coordinating customer comms: drafting a status update. Noting degraded performance in EU region and active mitigation (traffic shift + host drains).

dan-oncall: AWS support case opened (case# 123456789). They confirmed control plane EBS latencies may cause detaches. Asked for ETA.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled: dan-oncall -> ben-sre in 30m. Escalation path intact.

alice.dev: post-mitigation checks: 5xx down to ~2% after weight shift and draining, EBS latency trending down on replaced instances. Observed one noisy AZ (eu-west-3b) with disproportionate failures.

ben-sre: adding iptables rule to drop stale established on crashed backends? prefer not to, we're doing application-level fixes first.

dan-oncall: agree; continue drains and ASG replacements. Keep weights for 10-15m then reevaluate.

aws-alerts: Update: EBS API error rate reduced; latency improving. We continue to monitor.

carla-pm: when we have stable reduction to <1% 5xx for 20m, I'll prepare customer update to mark partial mitigation.

ben-sre: note for postmortem: investigate ELB idle_conn growth, nginx keepalive misconfig + EBS control plane coupling leading to detach storms. Create incident doc after stabilization.

alice.dev: quick snippet to check per-AZ unhealthy counts:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg:... | jq -r '.TargetHealthDescriptions[] | [.Target.Id, .TargetHealth.State, .TargetHealth.Reason] | @tsv' | sort
```

carla-pm: good. I'll collect CS tickets and impacted customer list. Anyone seeing persistent errors after 10:25Z shout here.

dan-oncall: last check: 5xx at 0.6% over 5m, EBS avg read latency normalized. Leaving handoff in 20m. Marking incident as mitigation in progress. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation action: Route53 weight shift -> eu-central-1, rolling drain/replacements in eu-west-3, nginx keepalive reduce, ASG lifecycle pauses.

carla-pm: thanks team — please add timeline and AWS case id to incident doc once case response is available.

ben-sre: Will open the postmortem ticket and assign to @alice.dev and @ben-sre for root cause analysis.

alice.dev: thumbs up. Will capture kernel / conntrack dumps and correlate with ELB idle stats.

aws-alerts: AWS update: root-cause analysis underway, no ETA for full resolution. Monitoring continues.

carla-pm: closing loop on comms: support notified, customers with SLAs flagged for follow-up.

dan-oncall: switching presence to read-only, ben taking active oncall.

ben-sre: taking over. continuing verification and will post final status once stable 30m window passed.

incident-bot: Thread archived when incident status=resolved.
